title: Brewster lights over the haunted-house garage
summary: Charles tells of Brewster lights over the haunted-house garage, about 1985-1986 at Brewster, New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
And he shows me, you know, we look up
and there's these six bright white
lights at the top of the trees just
hanging over the trees, just going over
the road, just uh, you know, not moving
very fast, just just hanging hanging out
in formation. No sound, no window,
nothing.

plain: A witness named Charles says that around 1985 or 1986, in Brewster, New York, someone showed him a strange sight by a garage at a house said to be haunted. He says they looked up and saw six bright white lights hanging just above the treetops in formation, drifting slowly over the road with no sound and no windows. It is told as one of many sightings reported in that area in those years.
